cases.description: Should trigger: mining session history for workflows
cases.input: Scan my last month of agent sessions and find patterns that should become skills.
cases.expect: Locates session archives, clusters repeated workflows, produces candidate list
assertions: Clusters repeated work by intent and tools used
Produces a shortlist with recurrence counts

cases.description: Should trigger: identifying a repeated manual workflow
cases.input: I keep asking you to format dates the same way every time. Make it a skill.
cases.expect: Recognizes this as a mining opportunity, drafts skill outline
assertions: Produces a named skill candidate with trigger description

cases.description: Should trigger: team backlog of candidates from actual work
cases.input: We want a backlog of candidate skills based on our team's real agent usage this quarter, not brainstorming.
cases.expect: Runs the scan-sessions.py first pass and scores candidates by recurrence, friction, risk, portability, value
assertions: Uses scripts/scan_sessions.py for a first-pass cluster report
Scores candidates on the 1-5 recurrence/friction/risk scale
Recommends personal vs public direction per candidate

cases.description: Should trigger: recurring procedure in project notes and scripts
cases.input: Our repo scripts and runbooks keep repeating the same release workflow. Is that skill-worthy?
cases.expect: Treats repeated scripts/notes as evidence, checks 3+ occurrences before drafting
assertions: Checks for 3+ repeat instances before drafting
Filters one-off tasks and project-specific AGENTS.md content

cases.input: Help me write a shell script to rename CSV headers.
cases.expect: Does not enter the mining workflow
assertions: Does not invoke the full mining procedure
Treats as a one-off coding task

cases.description: Not trigger: tuning an existing skill (routes to skill-personalizer)
cases.input: My invoice-parsing skill keeps missing UK VAT fields. Tune it to my company's tooling.
cases.expect: Does not mine; defers to skill-personalizer for existing-skill tuning
assertions: Recognizes this is tuning an existing skill, not mining
Points to skill-personalizer instead of drafting a new skill
